$comment: The house banned list: patterns a site must never ship. Each entry is a rule from guide/craft.md or guide/sites.md, or a correction the founder made on a real job. An entry with `detect` is enforced: `source` patterns by site:check, `dom` detectors (bin/site/banned.mjs) by site:audit and site:gate. An entry without `detect` goes to the critic's rubric (guide/banned.md). A client adds its own entries in brand/brand.json `rules` (see guide/banned.md). Add an entry and its detector in the same turn as the correction.

entries.rule: No eyebrows or kickers: no small uppercase label set over a heading.
entries.why: A label over a block that already says what it is is noise.
source: craft.md: Labels earn their place
Bob, CU Anschutz v14, 2026-10-27: "get rid of all eyebrows"

entries.rule: No accent-coloured text on a light ground. Accent colours are for rules, frames and fills; text stays ink.
entries.why: A light accent (gold, yellow, pale green) on a light ground fails contrast and reads as decoration.
source: Bob, CU Anschutz v4, 2026-10-27: "never gold text"

entries.rule: No accent-coloured underlines or bars under links and labels.
entries.why: An underline in the accent is a second link style and looks like a highlight, not a link.
source: Bob, CU Anschutz, 2026-10-27: gold underlines banned after v13 made them the secondary-action system

entries.rule: One primary action per screen; every other action is a text link. No outlined, ghost or bracketed secondary buttons.
entries.why: An outlined button competes with the primary and reads as a disabled or second-class button.
source: sites.md: One primary action per screen
Bob, CU Anschutz v12, 2026-10-27: "secondary button with outline feels like misuse / bad ux"

entries.rule: Nothing lifts on hover. Buttons press in; cards and tiles stay put.
entries.why: A hover lift is a template tell and moves the thing the reader is aiming at.
source: Bob, CU Anschutz v19, 2026-10-28: the service tile grid that lifts on hover

entries.rule: No blurred blobs, glows or noise filters as decoration. Use the brand's own textures, or nothing.
entries.why: Blur and generated noise read as amateur (sparkle dust).
source: craft.md 26 and 33
Bob, CU Anschutz v4, 2026-10-27: "hero looks like sparkle dust"

entries.rule: Photos don't wipe, slide, zoom or unmask in. A photo is simply there.
entries.why: Wipes and clip-path reveals look old and hold the content back.
source: Bob, CU Anschutz v6, 2026-10-27: photo wipes "really old school"

entries.rule: No in-page "On this page" bar or jump-link strip.
entries.why: A page short enough to read doesn't need a table of contents; a long one needs folding, not a bar.
source: Bob, CU Anschutz v15, 2026-10-27: the "On this page" bar removed (it had only been restyled)

entries.rule: No visible placeholders: no {{?…}}, "To confirm" chips, lorem ipsum, TBD, TODO or empty placeholder panels.
entries.why: Questions for the client go on the to-confirm list, never on the page.
source: Bob, CU Anschutz v20, 2026-10-28: "To confirm" chips on 10 pages

entries.rule: The hero is calm: the point, one primary action, at most one text link. No chips, no second button.
entries.why: Every first build crams the hero.
source: sites.md: The hero is calm
Bob, CU Anschutz v26, 2026-10-28: "why did you add services in the hero?"

entries.rule: No paragraph over the word limit outside a disclosure. Put detail one click away in a <details>.
entries.why: Walls of text don't get read.
source: sites.md: one click away (<details>)
Bob, CU Anschutz v20, 2026-10-28: "Lotttttt of walls of text"

entries.rule: No native select pickers on a desktop or tablet layout; use the brand's own menu (a native picker is fine on a phone).
entries.why: The OS picker ignores the brand and looks unfinished at desktop widths.
source: Bob, CU Anschutz v4, 2026-10-27: "native picker"

entries.why: Two lockups side by side read as a co-brand nobody asked for.
source: Bob, CU Anschutz v4, 2026-10-27: "double logos in header"

entries.rule: No draft, preview or work-in-progress banner on the page.
entries.why: Draft status belongs in the note that carries the link.
source: Bob, CU Anschutz v6, 2026-10-27: the draft banner

entries.rule: No clip-art: no CSS-drawn illustrations, cartoon objects, or supplied vectors used as decoration in tile grids.
entries.why: If an illustration wouldn't appear on the brand's own website, it doesn't go on the page.
source: craft.md 17
Bob, CU Anschutz v19, 2026-10-28: "looks like a 1990's illustration", the animated cartoon tooth
entries.rubric: Look for drawn or vector illustrations that decorate rather than explain: icon tiles, mascots, cartoon objects, CSS shapes. Each one is a blocking finding unless the brand's own site uses the same art the same way.

entries.rule: No equal-weight grids of three or four identical cards. Give one item the weight, or use a list.
entries.why: An equal three-up says nothing is more important than anything else.
source: craft.md 15
entries.rubric: A row of identical cards (same size, same parts, same emphasis) is a finding. Point to the card that should lead, or say the content wants a list.

entries.rule: Campaign compositions (sliced or stacked words, poster rows, bus-stop layouts) don't go on web pages.
entries.why: The brand guide's posters and banners are a different medium; the website example governs the site.
source: CU Anschutz retro, cause 2: sliced words on every service page, removed at v14
entries.rubric: Compare each component with the guide page that governs it (the website example for the hero). A composition taken from a poster, banner or bus shelter is a blocking finding.

entries.rule: One headline and at most one line under it. No second sub-headline.
entries.why: Two sub-headlines are an unedited draft.
source: Bob, CU Anschutz v15, 2026-10-27: "What's with the double sub-headlines?"
entries.rubric: Under any heading, two stacked lead lines or decks before the body is a finding: keep the stronger one.

entries.rule: Add nothing the brief and spec don't call for: no carousels, explorers, pickers or interactive objects nobody asked for.
entries.why: Each invention adds surface for bugs and taste violations.
source: CU Anschutz retro, cause 6
entries.rubric: List every interactive component on the page and whether the brief or spec asked for it. One nobody asked for is a finding.
